abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran, while the card DB lists the keyword as printed, so the card had it unconditionally. WHILE_STATIC re-evaluates the gate on every attack-power recalculation, and the printed copy is suppressed for any keyword a card grants itself conditionally. The Evo tiers are separate abilities because each names a different threshold; only the 'costs {r}{r}{r} less to play' tier is left unmodelled -- there is no board-state play-cost reduction, and it is flagged rather than approximated.

_comment: Was DESTROY_TOKEN, which destroys ONE token of a named slug that the CONTROLLER controls. 'destroy all cards defending this' names the cards declared as defenders on this chain link -- combat state, not a zone and not the arena, so no object-target spec can express it. Removed the 'costs {r}{r}{r} less to play' tier. It was a plain STATIC holding MODIFY_ATTACK subtract 3 -- a POWER penalty, not a cost reduction, so had anything dispatched it the card would have LOST 3{p} instead of costing less. NOT IMPLEMENTED: a play-cost reduction driven by board state (Evos equipped). The queued cost mods are one-shots created by an effect; there is no continuous 'this costs less while X' path. The other three tiers -- the on-hit destroy at 1+, overpower at 3+, +3{p} at 4+ -- are live, and CONTROLS_TOKEN_TYPE does reach equipment slots and match the Evo SUBTYPE, so their gates are real.
